snippet.title: Paw Rescuers : Early Gameplay
snippet.description:
Steam link in the comments.

Paw Rescuers is a cozy multiplayer open-world game packed with adventures. Craft tools, mine resources, and build homes and factories. Explore a vast world with friends and rescue adorable animals along the way!
